name: Стражник шахт
notes: A guard of the deep mines of Kragmir, a generic type fought in numbers. The mines keep their own guard, about a hundred dwarves plus constructs, and it is a separate force from the army detachment at the fort. Guards police the mining town and fight to arrest: the sap, manacles, and shouted orders come first, and the mace comes out only after the party has killed a guard. Kragmir's guard has no mages. Every guard carries Effect: Under Command, so a Капитан стражи шахт's Aura of Command buffs it automatically within 30 feet.

actions.name: Lay Down the Law
actions.text:
Requirements The guard's last action this turn was a successful Strike against a creature within 30 feet

Effect The guard yells a command at the creature they hit. The target must succeed at a @Check[will|dc:22] save or spend the first action on its next turn doing as commanded (or all its actions on its next turn on a critical failure). The guard can command a creature to approach the guard, release what its holding, or drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone]. Regardless of the result of its save, the creature is temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

actions.name: Efficient Capture
actions.text:
Requirements The guard has manacles in hand and is adjacent to a creature

Effect The guard attempts to bind the creature's wrists or ankles with the manacles. If the guard succeeds at an attack roll with a [[/r 1d20+11 #Manacles]]{+11 modifier} against the target's AC, they apply the manacles.

actions.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
actions.text: Dwarves are often calm and collected in the face of imminent danger. At the end of the guard's turn, reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened] condition by 2 instead of 1.

description.value: You are commanded by a captain of the guard.
